title: Probe Lantern: Customer vignettes and priority stitches (Mar 2031)
body:
Purpose / context:
This is a compact synthesis of recent voice-of-customer across Enterprise Beta accounts (Dec 2030 -> Feb 2031). Goal: surface 4 rapid vignettes, map to a small set of low-to-medium-effort probes, and propose a prioritized stitch list for Q2 planning. Treat this as a working lantern — highlights and shadowed questions are expected.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Customers repeatedly call out: unpredictable tail latency spikes during chat-heavy sessions, confusing model-fallback behavior under quota or capacity limits, and telemetry gaps for per-route token-cost attribution.
- Three feasible low-risk patches (prefix-KV visibility, soft-fallback logging, route-level billing tags) could materially reduce support load and unblock a handful of pilot expansions.
- Two mid-weight product changes (graceful multi-model rollouts with observable canaries; dedicated burst policy UI) should be scoped with infra and hosting product partners.

Vignettes (concrete customer stories)
1) "Retail Catalog Chat" (Large e-commerce, USA)
- Symptom: During peak traffic windows the customer's product chat would show a 10-20% increase in 95th/99th latency. They saw sudden model-switching to smaller quantized variants and unexplained token-cost surges.
- Impact: Daily syncs with their SRE and platform team; delayed release of a catalog-search/assistant feature; churn risk for a second pilot.
- Customer quote (paraphrased): "We need predictable SLOs and a clear map of why the model changed mid-session — our legal/compliance teams require that behavior be explainable."
- Quick hypothesis: routing fallback + insufficient session affinity + telemetry gaps that hide prefix/KV cache reuse.

2) "Financial Advice Embedder" (Mid-market fintech, EU)
- Symptom: Embeddings throughput regressed after a private deployment upgrade; customers saw throughput drop ~30% and occasional OOM retries.
- Impact: Daily batch jobs missed SLAs; finance team billed for additional compute unexpectedly.
- Quick notes: Private deployment had a new kernel selection for quantized weights; the upgrade was rolled globally without a canary pinned to a small workspace.
- Risk flag: On-prem customers expect clearer rollback/upgrade playbooks.

3) "Support Summarizer" (SaaS helpdesk, APAC region)
- Symptom: Users reported inconsistent summaries depending on input length; two similar threads produced divergent outputs after a model patch.
- Impact: Product trust issue; customer escalated asking for ability to pin model versions per-route.
- Observation: They do not want a manual long-term workaround; they want first-class per-route model pinning + audit logs.

4) "Partner POC — Multi-tenant burst" (Startup marketplace)
- Symptom: Burst demand during a marketing event exhausted their Dedicated pool; autoscale lag meant failed requests. They expected soft-fallback to hosted API or queued bursts.
- Impact: Lost transactions and PR noise.
- Proposed short fix: quick policy to route overflow to lower-cost compatible models + a per-tenant burst credit dashboard.

Priority stitch list (proposed ordering + rough impact/effort)
- A: Prefix / KV cache visibility (impact: high, effort: small-medium)
  - Why: unlocks explanations for latency variance and helps customers tune prompt engineering.
  - Quick patch: expose per-session cache hit/miss counts in request traces and at the token-level dashboard.
- B: Soft-fallback audit logging (impact: high, effort: small)
  - Why: customers need to know when a model fallback occurred and why (capacity, quota, version mismatch).
  - Quick patch: add a single-line event in request traces and an alert in console for any fallback during a time window.
- C: Route-level billing tags & per-route token breakdown (impact: medium, effort: medium)
  - Why: finance teams require allocation across business units; reduces dispute friction.
- D: Canaryable model rollouts with canary trace shows (impact: high, effort: medium-high)
  - Why: prevents silent regressions like the Support Summarizer divergence.
- E: Dedicated burst failover policy + tenant burst credits (impact: high for Dedicated customers, effort: medium)

Engineering quick patches (concrete steps)
- Add two new trace fields: fallback_reason and kv_cache_hit_rate (SDK + REST header).
- Emit a lightweight event to existing observability pipeline when routing fallback occurs (tag: fallback, model_from, model_to, reason).
- Add a per-route billing_tag property in the API; wire it into cost breakdown pipeline (stopgap: accept string tags and surface in CSV export).

Product/Support playbook (short term)
- Draft customer-facing KB article: "Why did my model change mid-session?" (includes detection steps, how to pin model versions, contact routing). Owner: Ruth Kim.
- Support-run: pro-actively surface customers with >2 fallbacks/week and offer a diagnostic call. Owner: Diego.
- Release note callout for any routing policy changes.

Open questions / unknowns
- Will exposing kv_cache_hit_rate leak PII through traces? We need SRE/privacy review.
- For private deployments: can kernel-selector rollback be automated or must it be manual? (Infra clarification required).
- Is there regulatory concern with per-route billing tags (EU customer asked about GDPR data-correlation) — check with security/compliance.

Suggested owners & next actions (1-2 week sprint)
- Aisha (owner of doc): coordinate scoping session, set up short sync with serving-runtime and infra.
- Diego: run a lightweight log search for fallback events across pilot customers (deliverable: sample table + 3 customer examples) by 2029-11-29.
- Ruth: draft KB article and send to legal & support for review by 2031-03-19.
- Samir (SRE liasion): assess privacy exposures for new trace fields by 2031-03-25.

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep this doc as a short-lived working lantern. If we hit agreement on A/B patches, convert to Confluence spec and link.
- Don't overcommit on UI timelines — prefer shipping telemetry + logging first and then iterate on console surfaces.

Appendix: quick mapping to existing tickets and threads
- Observability pipeline spike: JIRA:CS-8721 (linked above)
- Private deployment upgrade log: GH PR #1428 in infra/kernel-selection (ask infra for cross-link)
- Customer Slack thread: #cust-ops-feb31 (internal) — permalink saved in team notebook.

End.
